a: STRIDE: Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Info disclosure, DoS, Elevation.
Attack surface is the set of ways an attacker can try to enter.
Service accounts should have minimal permissions.
Manage key lifecycle: create, rotate, revoke, destroy.
HSMs protect cryptographic keys in hardened hardware.
Pinning limits which certificates a client will trust.
Secure boot verifies firmware/OS integrity at startup.
Memory-safe languages reduce whole classes of bugs.
Fuzzing feeds random inputs to find crashes and bugs.
Bug bounties pay researchers for responsibly reported issues.
